title: Dimensional Rift
description: A stable rift between dimensions hums with impossible energy, its edges perfectly circular and utterly black. The air around it tastes of ozone and forgotten languages. Objects tossed near it stretch into infinity before vanishing, and thin membranes of compressed space peel away from its boundary like shed skin.

choices.label: Extract dimensional essence
choices.description: Carefully siphon the raw dimensional energy bleeding from the rift's stable edges.

outcomes.text: The energy flows smoothly into your collection vessel, thrumming with the pulse of two overlapping realities. A clean extraction.
The rift flickers as you drain it, spitting sparks of displaced energy. You get the essence, but one hero catches a bolt square in the chest.
The rift destabilizes! A shockwave of compressed space slams outward, bruising everyone and scattering your tools. A fragment of rift membrane clings to your collection vessel.

choices.label: Reach through for valuables
choices.description: Blindly fish through the rift, hoping to pull back something worth the risk.

outcomes.text: Your arm stretches impossibly as it crosses the threshold. You grab something heavy and yank it back — a pouch of coins from some other reality.
You pull back a handful of rift membrane and some null fragments caught between dimensions. Not gold, but valuable in their own right.
Something on the other side grabs back! Your arm is wrenched violently before you tear free. The rift pulses with malevolent hunger.

choices.label: Leave it alone
choices.description: Stable does not mean safe. You move on.

outcomes.text: You give the rift a wide berth. It hums indifferently as you pass, neither inviting nor threatening — simply existing where it should not.
